facts.fact: The director general of the Institut national de la statistique said on 5 June 2026 that the Open Data Portal is at work and anyone can access and download data from it in Excel, PDF and Word formats.

The INS director general said the institute has begun loading onto the Open Data Portal not only its own data but the output of sectoral ministries and other national agencies with statistics; no body other than the INS is named.

note: Data governance assessment event; no data published for download or open data portal stated.

facts.fact: The SYNA-MNV programme of Congo's forest economy ministry publishes five datasets for download on its open data page, the newest dated 2024.
The SYNA-MNV programme states its datasets are published under an open licence, with reuse requiring the credit 'Source : SYNA-MNV - Republique du Congo'.

note: The page is a provisional draft of site terms awaiting validation, not terms in force, and shows no dataset published.
